title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (16/20): Burning the Poems
note_en: Repeating a measure word and adding 地 describes something happening one by one or bit by bit: 一张一张地放进火盆里 "put them into the brazier one sheet at a time," and 纸灰一点一点地飘起来 "the ash drifted up little by little." English needs a phrase like "one by one" or "sheet after sheet," while Chinese simply doubles 一 + measure word.
